# Exact normal-mean test calculations and plots. This file uses base R only.

assert_scalar_number <- function(value, name) {
  if (!is.numeric(value) || length(value) != 1L || !is.finite(value)) {
    stop(name, " must be a single finite number.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(value)
}

normal_interval_probability <- function(lower, upper, mean, sd) {
  # Use upper tails when both endpoints are above the mean to avoid cancellation.
  if (lower >= mean) {
    probability <- pnorm(lower, mean, sd, lower.tail = FALSE) -
      pnorm(upper, mean, sd, lower.tail = FALSE)
  } else {
    probability <- pnorm(upper, mean, sd) - pnorm(lower, mean, sd)
  }
  max(0, min(1, probability))
}

normal_mean_test <- function(mu0 = 15, mu_alt = 14.8, sigma = 0.5, n = 50,
                             alpha = 0.05, tail = "left", rule = "alpha",
                             cutoff = 14.9, half_width = 0.1) {
  #' Calculate test size, Type II error, and power for a normal-mean Z test.
  #'
  #' Observations are independent N(mu, sigma^2), with known sigma. The bounds
  #' describe the nonrejection interval. For one-sided tests, mu0 is the null
  #' boundary. beta is NA when the selected true mean does not satisfy H_a.
  for (name in c("mu0", "mu_alt", "sigma", "n")) {
    assert_scalar_number(get(name), name)
  }
  if (sigma <= 0) stop("Population SD must be positive.", call. = FALSE)
  if (n < 1 || n != floor(n)) {
    stop("Sample size must be a positive whole number.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  tail <- match.arg(tail, c("left", "right", "two"))
  rule <- match.arg(rule, c("alpha", "cutoff"))
  se <- sigma / sqrt(n)
  lower <- -Inf
  upper <- Inf
  if (rule == "alpha") {
    assert_scalar_number(alpha, "alpha")
    if (alpha <= 0 || alpha >= 1) {
      stop("Alpha must lie strictly between zero and one.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    if (tail == "left") lower <- mu0 + qnorm(alpha) * se
    if (tail == "right") upper <- mu0 + qnorm(alpha, lower.tail = FALSE) * se
    if (tail == "two") {
      margin <- qnorm(alpha / 2, lower.tail = FALSE) * se
      lower <- mu0 - margin
      upper <- mu0 + margin
    }
  } else if (tail == "two") {
    assert_scalar_number(half_width, "half_width")
    if (half_width <= 0) stop("Half-width must be positive.", call. = FALSE)
    lower <- mu0 - half_width
    upper <- mu0 + half_width
  } else {
    assert_scalar_number(cutoff, "cutoff")
    if (tail == "left") lower <- cutoff else upper <- cutoff
  }
  reject_probability <- function(mean) {
    pnorm(lower, mean, se) + pnorm(upper, mean, se, lower.tail = FALSE)
  }
  actual_alpha <- reject_probability(mu0)
  rejection <- reject_probability(mu_alt)
  nonrejection <- normal_interval_probability(lower, upper, mu_alt, se)
  is_alternative <- switch(tail, left = mu_alt < mu0,
                            right = mu_alt > mu0, two = mu_alt != mu0)
  list(mu0 = mu0, mu_alt = mu_alt, sigma = sigma, n = n, se = se,
       nominal_alpha = if (rule == "alpha") alpha else NA_real_,
       alpha = actual_alpha, beta = if (is_alternative) nonrejection else NA_real_,
       nonrejection = nonrejection, power = rejection,
       is_alternative = is_alternative, tail = tail, rule = rule,
       lower = lower, upper = upper, cutoff = cutoff, half_width = half_width)
}

normal_test_profile <- function(parameters, variable = c("alpha", "n"), values) {
  #' Recalculate probabilities across a sequence of alpha values or sample sizes.
  variable <- match.arg(variable)
  results <- lapply(values, function(value) {
    selected <- parameters
    selected[[variable]] <- value
    if (variable == "alpha") selected$rule <- "alpha"
    normal_mean_test_result <- do.call(normal_mean_test, selected)
    c(alpha = normal_mean_test_result$alpha,
      nonrejection = normal_mean_test_result$nonrejection,
      rejection = normal_mean_test_result$power)
  })
  data.frame(value = values, do.call(rbind, results), row.names = NULL)
}

test_rule_text <- function(result, digits = 4) {
  #' Express the rejection rule on the sample-mean scale.
  number <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)
  switch(result$tail,
         left = paste("Reject H0 if the sample mean is below", number(result$lower)),
         right = paste("Reject H0 if the sample mean is above", number(result$upper)),
         two = paste("Reject H0 if the sample mean is below", number(result$lower),
                     "or above", number(result$upper)))
}

test_colors <- c(null = "#184a75", alternative = "#423a65",
                 alpha = "#c44145", beta = "#cf9528", power = "#137b6d")

propellant_comparison <- function(mu0 = 50, mu_alt = 52, sigma = 2.5,
                                  reference_n = 10, current_n = 16,
                                  reference_width = 1.5, current_width = 2,
                                  alpha_control = "width", alpha_current = 0.01,
                                  alpha_fixed = 0.05, experiment = "alpha") {
  #' Define a reference and changed test for the Class18 propellant example.
  #' Keep all changes explicit: cutoffs, alpha, or sample size, with a fixed model.
  experiment <- match.arg(experiment, c("alpha", "n_cutoff", "n_alpha"))
  alpha_control <- match.arg(alpha_control, c("width", "alpha"))
  reference_parameters <- list(mu0 = mu0, mu_alt = mu_alt, sigma = sigma,
    n = reference_n, tail = "two", rule = "cutoff", half_width = reference_width)
  current_parameters <- reference_parameters
  if (experiment == "alpha") {
    if (alpha_control == "width") {
      current_parameters$half_width <- current_width
    } else {
      current_parameters$rule <- "alpha"
      current_parameters$alpha <- alpha_current
    }
  } else {
    current_parameters$n <- current_n
    if (experiment == "n_alpha") {
      reference_parameters$rule <- current_parameters$rule <- "alpha"
      reference_parameters$alpha <- current_parameters$alpha <- alpha_fixed
    }
  }
  list(reference = do.call(normal_mean_test, reference_parameters),
       current = do.call(normal_mean_test, current_parameters),
       reference_parameters = reference_parameters,
       current_parameters = current_parameters, experiment = experiment)
}

comparison_table <- function(comparison) {
  #' Return the probability summary for the two displayed sampling models.
  rows <- lapply(c("reference", "current"), function(name) {
    result <- comparison[[name]]
    data.frame(Setting = tools::toTitleCase(name), n = result$n,
      SE = round(result$se, 4),
      `Nonrejection interval` = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", result$lower, result$upper),
      alpha = round(result$alpha, 4),
      beta = if (result$is_alternative) round(result$beta, 4) else NA_real_,
      power = round(result$power, 4), check.names = FALSE)
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

plot_propellant_comparison <- function(comparison, show_power = FALSE,
                                       reference_outline = TRUE, compact = FALSE) {
  #' Overlay H0 and Ha in each of two panels, with shared axes and error areas.
  reference <- comparison$reference
  current <- comparison$current
  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par))
  par(mfrow = if (compact) c(1, 2) else c(2, 1),
      mar = if (compact) c(3.8, 3.8, 4.2, 0.8) else c(4.0, 4.3, 3.1, 0.9),
      mgp = if (compact) c(2.3, 0.6, 0) else c(2.45, 0.7, 0),
      oma = c(0.2, 0, 0, 0), las = 1, cex = 1.08,
      col.axis = "#34495e", col.lab = "#243b50", col.main = "#172b40")
  # This envelope stays unchanged when the cutoffs or current n change.
  xlim <- range(c(reference$mu0, reference$mu_alt)) +
    c(-1, 1) * 4.2 * reference$sigma / sqrt(min(5, reference$n))
  ymax <- max(dnorm(0, sd = reference$se), dnorm(0, sd = current$se)) * 1.32
  x <- sort(unique(c(seq(xlim[1], xlim[2], length.out = 3500),
                     reference$mu0, reference$mu_alt)))

  draw_panel <- function(result, title, outline = FALSE) {
    plot(x, dnorm(x, result$mu0, result$se), type = "n", xlim = xlim,
      ylim = c(0, ymax),
      xlab = if (compact) "Sample mean (cm/sec)" else "Sample mean burning rate (cm/sec)",
      ylab = "Density", main = if (compact) "" else title)
    if (compact) title(main = title, line = 2.9)
    abline(h = pretty(c(0, ymax)), col = "#edf1f4", lwd = 1)
    shade_normal_area(result$mu_alt, result$se, result$lower, result$upper,
                      xlim, test_colors['beta'])
    if (show_power) {
      shade_normal_area(result$mu_alt, result$se, -Inf, result$lower,
                        xlim, test_colors['power'])
      shade_normal_area(result$mu_alt, result$se, result$upper, Inf,
                        xlim, test_colors['power'])
    }
    shade_normal_area(result$mu0, result$se, -Inf, result$lower,
                      xlim, test_colors['alpha'])
    shade_normal_area(result$mu0, result$se, result$upper, Inf,
                      xlim, test_colors['alpha'])
    if (outline && reference$n != result$n) {
      lines(x, dnorm(x, reference$mu0, reference$se), col = "#9caab6", lty = 3)
      lines(x, dnorm(x, reference$mu_alt, reference$se), col = "#9caab6", lty = 3)
    }
    lines(x, dnorm(x, result$mu0, result$se), col = test_colors['null'], lwd = 2.7)
    lines(x, dnorm(x, result$mu_alt, result$se), col = "#222222", lwd = 2.7)
    segments(c(result$lower, result$upper), 0,
             c(result$lower, result$upper), ymax * 0.86,
             col = "#9b3035", lty = 2, lwd = 1.7)
    legend("top", inset = 0.005,
      legend = c(sprintf("H0: mean %g", result$mu0),
                 sprintf("%s: mean %g", if (result$is_alternative) "Ha" else "Selected", result$mu_alt)),
      col = c(test_colors['null'], "#222222"), lwd = 2.7, horiz = TRUE,
      bty = "n", cex = if (compact) 0.75 else 0.9)
    beta_text <- if (result$is_alternative) sprintf("beta = %.4f", result$beta) else
      sprintf("nonrejection = %.4f", result$nonrejection)
    if (compact) {
      mtext(sprintf("n = %d; SE = %.4f", result$n, result$se),
            side = 3, line = 1.35, adj = 0, cex = 0.86)
      mtext(sprintf("alpha = %.4f; %s", result$alpha, beta_text),
            side = 3, line = 0.25, adj = 0, cex = 0.86)
    } else {
      mtext(sprintf("n = %d; SE = %.4f; alpha = %.4f; %s",
                    result$n, result$se, result$alpha, beta_text),
            side = 3, line = 0.25, adj = 0, cex = 0.86)
    }
    if (result$nonrejection > 0.02 && result$is_alternative) {
      midpoint <- (pnorm(result$lower, result$mu_alt, result$se) +
                     pnorm(result$upper, result$mu_alt, result$se)) / 2
      beta_x <- qnorm(midpoint, result$mu_alt, result$se)
      beta_label <- bquote(beta == .(round(result$beta, 4)))
      label_width <- strwidth(beta_label, cex = 1.0)
      left_limit <- max(xlim[1], result$lower) + 0.55 * label_width
      right_limit <- min(xlim[2], result$upper) - 0.55 * label_width
      if (is.finite(beta_x) && left_limit <= right_limit) {
        beta_x <- max(left_limit, min(right_limit, beta_x))
        beta_y <- dnorm(beta_x, result$mu_alt, result$se) * 0.32
        text(beta_x, beta_y, beta_label, cex = 1.0, font = 2, col = "#61420b")
      }
    }
  }
  draw_panel(reference, "1. Reference")
  draw_panel(current, "2. Changed setting", outline = reference_outline)
  invisible(comparison)
}

shade_normal_area <- function(mean, sd, lower, upper, xlim, color) {
  #' Fill only the part of a probability region visible on a density plot.
  left <- max(lower, xlim[1])
  right <- min(upper, xlim[2])
  if (left >= right) return(invisible(NULL))
  x <- seq(left, right, length.out = 700)
  polygon(c(left, x, right), c(0, dnorm(x, mean, sd), 0),
          col = adjustcolor(color, alpha.f = 0.55), border = NA)
  invisible(NULL)
}

plot_test_distributions <- function(result) {
  #' Show Type I error under H0 and nonrejection/rejection under the selected mean.
  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par))
  par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(3.4, 4.2, 2.6, 1.1),
      oma = c(0.3, 0, 0, 0), las = 1, cex = 1.08,
      col.axis = "#34495e", col.lab = "#243b50", col.main = "#172b40")
  # The envelope uses the UI's minimum n=5, so changing n does not rescale x.
  centers <- c(result$mu0, result$mu_alt)
  if (result$rule == "cutoff") {
    centers <- c(centers, c(result$lower, result$upper)[
      is.finite(c(result$lower, result$upper))])
  }
  xlim <- range(centers) + c(-1, 1) * 4.2 * result$sigma / sqrt(5)
  x <- sort(unique(c(seq(xlim[1], xlim[2], length.out = 3000),
                     result$mu0, result$mu_alt)))
  ymax <- dnorm(result$mu0, result$mu0, result$se) * 1.15
  boundary <- c(result$lower, result$upper)
  boundary <- boundary[is.finite(boundary)]

  plot(x, dnorm(x, result$mu0, result$se), type = "n", ylim = c(0, ymax),
       xlim = xlim, xlab = "Sample mean", ylab = "Density",
       main = bquote("Under the null:" ~ mu[0] == .(result$mu0)))
  shade_normal_area(result$mu0, result$se, -Inf, result$lower, xlim,
                    test_colors['alpha'])
  shade_normal_area(result$mu0, result$se, result$upper, Inf, xlim,
                    test_colors['alpha'])
  lines(x, dnorm(x, result$mu0, result$se), lwd = 2.5, col = test_colors['null'])
  abline(v = boundary, lty = 2, lwd = 1.6, col = "#253746")
  legend("topright", legend = sprintf("Type I error: alpha = %.4f", result$alpha),
         fill = adjustcolor(test_colors['alpha'], 0.55), border = NA,
         bty = "n", cex = 0.95)

  plot(x, dnorm(x, result$mu_alt, result$se), type = "n", ylim = c(0, ymax),
       xlim = xlim, xlab = "Sample mean", ylab = "Density",
       main = bquote("At the selected true mean:" ~ mu[a] == .(result$mu_alt)))
  shade_normal_area(result$mu_alt, result$se, result$lower, result$upper, xlim,
                    test_colors['beta'])
  shade_normal_area(result$mu_alt, result$se, -Inf, result$lower, xlim,
                    test_colors['power'])
  shade_normal_area(result$mu_alt, result$se, result$upper, Inf, xlim,
                    test_colors['power'])
  lines(x, dnorm(x, result$mu_alt, result$se), lwd = 2.5,
        col = test_colors['alternative'])
  abline(v = boundary, lty = 2, lwd = 1.6, col = "#253746")
  labels <- if (result$is_alternative) {
    c(sprintf("Type II error: beta = %.4f", result$beta),
      sprintf("Power = %.4f", result$power))
  } else {
    c(sprintf("Nonrejection = %.4f", result$nonrejection),
      sprintf("Rejection = %.4f", result$power))
  }
  legend("topright", legend = labels,
         fill = adjustcolor(test_colors[c('beta', 'power')], 0.55),
         border = NA, bty = "n", cex = 0.95)
  invisible(result)
}

plot_test_profile <- function(profile, result, variable = c("alpha", "n")) {
  #' Plot error probabilities and rejection probability on a common 0-1 scale.
  variable <- match.arg(variable)
  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par))
  par(mar = c(4.1, 4.2, 2.2, 0.8), las = 1, cex = 1.05,
      col.axis = "#34495e", col.lab = "#243b50", col.main = "#172b40")
  xlab <- if (variable == "alpha") "Chosen significance level (alpha)" else "Sample size (n)"
  plot(profile$value, profile$nonrejection, type = "n", ylim = c(0, 1),
       xlab = xlab, ylab = "Probability", yaxs = "i",
       main = if (variable == "alpha") "Changing alpha" else "Changing sample size")
  abline(h = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8), col = "#e3e9ef", lwd = 1)
  lines(profile$value, profile$nonrejection, col = test_colors['beta'], lwd = 2.5, lty = 2)
  lines(profile$value, profile$rejection, col = test_colors['power'], lwd = 2.5, lty = 1)
  labels <- if (result$is_alternative) c("beta", "power") else c("nonrejection", "rejection")
  colors <- test_colors[c('beta', 'power')]
  linetypes <- c(2, 1)
  if (variable == "n") {
    lines(profile$value, profile$alpha, col = test_colors['alpha'], lwd = 2.5, lty = 3)
    labels <- c(labels, "alpha")
    colors <- c(colors, test_colors['alpha'])
    linetypes <- c(linetypes, 3)
  }
  selected_x <- if (variable == "alpha") result$alpha else result$n
  abline(v = selected_x, col = "#60778b", lty = 3)
  points(rep(selected_x, 2), c(result$nonrejection, result$power),
         pch = c(22, 21), bg = test_colors[c('beta', 'power')],
         col = colors[1:2], cex = 1.25)
  legend("top", legend = labels, col = colors, lwd = 2.5, lty = linetypes,
         bty = "n", horiz = TRUE, cex = 0.85)
  invisible(profile)
}
